_about: The race server's custom blocks. BlockTextures.zip has the mod's models and pictures but NO block definitions, so every block NAME here is a guess taken from the model folder / picture file name, and which picture goes on which model was found by rendering the candidates (tools/race_blocks/README.md). If a name is wrong, fix it here or give tools/make_ai_prompt.py the real list with --race-names. 'rot' says how the block sits at rotation 0; rotation N turns it N quarter turns anticlockwise seen from above (north -> west -> south -> east), the same way stairs turn. 'conf': 'model' = name from a model folder, 'texture' = name only from a picture file.
